incidente.resumo: On 12 November 2021, Google's Front End load balancing service experienced failures that impacted several downstream Google Cloud services in Europe; preliminary analysis attributes it to a new infrastructure feature triggering a latent issue in internal network load balancer code. The issue was mitigated about 1 hour 44 minutes after it began, when the engineering team completed a rollout to disable the vulnerable code path.
